prs.title: [#210] Record P0 verification and safe M4 mutation rehearsal

nodes.body: Reviewed the scope and verification plan for #210. The task covers the key P0 workflows, deployed UI validation, database persistence, and M4 test evidence. The proposed approach is consistent with the acceptance criteria and existing test dependencies. However, the evidence for browser-level response times and the controlled mutation test could be documented more clearly, particularly the actual results and recovery steps. Overall, the verification plan is well-structured, with a few minor improvements needed to strengthen the final evidence before approval.
nodes.substantive_assessment: Substantive independent Review changes: identifies concrete verification/traceability gaps. Approval does not prove those gaps resolved.

prs.title: [#206] Add database readiness and sanitized request monitoring

nodes.body: Reviewed the requirements for #206. The proposed health checks and request monitoring cover the main objectives, including database availability, proper HTTP status codes, and sanitized logging. However, the error rate and response time thresholds should be documented more clearly, and the database failure tests need sufficient evidence to confirm that sensitive information is not exposed. Overall, the approach is reasonable, with a few minor improvements needed before final approval.
nodes.substantive_assessment: Substantive independent Review changes: identifies concrete verification/traceability gaps. Approval does not prove those gaps resolved.

prs.title: [#205] Prepare persistent Render deployment and green-gated releases

nodes.body: Reviewed the deployment requirements for #205. The deployment approach covers the main objectives, including public HTTPS access, CI-gated releases, secure environment configuration, and rollback support. However, the evidence for blocking deployments when CI fails could be documented more clearly, and the rollback verification steps need a bit more detail. These are minor points to address before final approval, while the overall approach aligns well with the Sprint 5 requirements.
nodes.substantive_assessment: Substantive independent Review changes: identifies concrete verification/traceability gaps. Approval does not prove those gaps resolved.

prs.title: [#203] Prepare UI before/after evidence and identify missing M3 sources

nodes.body: Reviewed the work for #203. The two UI improvements are clearly presented and aligned with the M3 feedback requirements. The before-and-after comparisons help demonstrate the changes effectively, and the supporting evidence is generally well-organized. However, the links to the original feedback and implementation PRs could be documented more clearly to improve traceability. Overall, the work meets the main objectives, with only minor documentation improvements suggested.
nodes.substantive_assessment: Substantive independent Review changes: identifies concrete verification/traceability gaps. Approval does not prove those gaps resolved.

nodes.body: Can we double-check the database backup behavior? Since this PR adds backup and recovery support, I want to make sure a failed backup won't affect the original database, and that restoring data won't accidentally overwrite an existing database. The tests are passing, but I think this part is worth checking before merging.
nodes.substantive_assessment: Substantive independent Review changes: identifies concrete verification/traceability gaps. Approval does not prove those gaps resolved.

prs.title: [#185] Verify US04 completed counts with 19, 20 and 21 responses

nodes.body: Reviewed the implementation for #185. The test cases effectively cover the 19, 20, and 21 completed-response scenarios, ensuring accurate evaluation counts while excluding draft submissions. Both API responses and lecturer dashboard counts are consistently validated, with proper test isolation and no impact on existing functionality. The implementation aligns with the acceptance criteria, and no blocking issues were identified.

prs.title: [#184] Complete US03 rating, text and required-answer boundaries

nodes.body: Reviewed the implementation for #184. All rating, text length, and required-answer boundary cases are properly covered. The tests follow the specified requirements, invalid submissions are handled correctly, and existing functionality remains unaffected. No blocking issues found.
